content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WAPCOS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WAPCOS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application submission is 24 August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this WAPCOS recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for Various Posts on Deputation in WAPCOS.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the WAPCOS Various Posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 56 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these WAPCOS posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: Educational qualifications vary by post, including B.Tech/B.E. in relevant engineering fields, MBA in Personnel Management, and Master's in Geology/Applied Geology, along with specific years of experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from IDA E-5 to E-7, with specific pay scales mentioned for each post, such as Rs. 80,000-2,20,000/- to Rs. 1,00,000-2,60,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Haryana apply for this WAPCOS job?
faq.answer: The notification mentions the location as Gurugram, Haryana. While the application is online, candidates should check the deputation terms and conditions for eligibility regarding their current employment status and location.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this WAPCOS recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type is Deputation, meaning candidates will be appointed on a temporary basis from their parent organization.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official WAPCOS Recruitment 2026 notification?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for easy access.
